svg.title: An invented forum assembles from public source fragments
svg.desc: Assemble an ordinary invented room from source-document fragments with no official insignia. The reader must see a constructed accountability forum, not a reported hearing. Keep the paper-fragment perimeter and four empty wall bays visible as invented staging, with no official chamber insignia.
